## Save facts / reader proposals

<!-- N/A if no game data changes. Do not claim a missing public gate passed. -->

- [ ] Every displayed field has independently checked meaning and stage/source provenance

- [ ] Author/community and current/furthest/historical values distinguished
- [ ] Unproven fields hidden; evidence and exclusions documented
- [ ] Originals read-only; no game launches or Steam restarts during research
- [ ] No personal saves/IDs, extracted localization or game content in a reader proposal
